hook: One palladium cage turns into a bowl or a helicate depending on which guest molecule is added.
hook_turn: depending on which guest molecule is added.
summary: A flexible ligand with palladium forms a cage, and different guest molecules push it into a bowl or a triple-stranded helicate. Guests can be added, removed, or swapped to move between the three shapes, shown by guest-exchange experiments. The switching is shown for one ligand design; a rigid biphenyl analogue did not switch.
title: Guest-Directed Navigation of a Ligand Conformational Landscape Enables Palladium-Organic Cage-Bowl-Helicate Interconversion.
